text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan inaugurates the new headquarters of Moroccan foreign ministry.
- President Yasser Arafat due in Morocco on Tuesday.
- Moroccan Progress and Socialism Party sends condolence message to the Chinese communist party following the death of Deng Xiaoping.
- Morocco has been held up as an example in an United Nations agency report for its anti-drug efforts.
